findings.title: Consolidate the three model boolean filters into one multi-select
evidence: app/models/page.tsx:30-33 parses priced, active, and recent-open independently
app/models/page.tsx:54-62 applies all three before sorting and pagination

findings.implementation: Add one checklist-style filter popover for priced, active, and recent-open while retaining the existing URL names and predicates. Checkbox changes must continue to submit through AutoSubmitForm, omit false priced/active values, emit recent-open=0 when disabled, and reset page by omission. The requirement changes only the presentation of spec ui-conventions-019; its current-currency, pre-sort, pre-pagination, and URL-retention semantics remain binding.
acceptance: One multi-select control exposes all three independently selectable options
Every combination maps to the same priced/active/recent-open query contract
Changing an option returns to page 1 and preserves search, ability, weights, sort, and columns

providers, lifecycle, license, downloads, likes, and all board columns are opt-in

findings.title: Persist model and compare column selections independently
evidence: components/column-picker.tsx:18-69 is a server-rendered URL-only form control
lib/model-columns.ts:73-90 treats empty/unknown as defaults and serializes an empty set as an absent value

findings.implementation: Use distinct browser keys llm-info:models:columns:v1 and llm-info:compare:columns:v1. Define precedence as explicit URL cols, then the page key, then page defaults. Add an explicit none sentinel to parseVisibleColumns/serializeColumns so zero selected columns round-trips. On apply, persist the ordered selection and navigate with cols while retaining page state; on reset-columns, clear only that page key and cols while preserving filters/sort. Never let the models key affect compare or vice versa.
acceptance: Selections survive refresh and navigation away/back
An empty selection remains empty rather than restoring defaults
Models and compare store independent values
Reset columns affects only its table and does not reset filters

findings.title: Use board-typed normalization, strict owner evidence, official-canonical preference, and maximum score
evidence: src/model-index/match.js:3-27 globally removes semantic base/instruct/thinking suffixes
src/model-index/match.js:37-44 uses broad prefix owner compatibility
src/model-index/match.js:75-83 prefers channel/price/quality counts rather than direct official evidence
src/model-index/match.js:89-110 enforces owner only when ownerRequired is set
src/model-index/build.js:15-42 already retains the highest score after multiple rows map to one canonical ID
src/model-index/config.js:6-77 supplies board kind and per-board match policy
findings.implementation: Replace universal semantic-token deletion with a strategy selected by board kind. Benchmark/quality strategies may strip only recognized effort annotations such as (high|medium|low|xhigh) and thinking-token budgets; repository matching must preserve Base/Instruct/Thinking and other architecture variants. When organization exists, reject incompatible owners for every strategy; owner equivalence must use the established strict separator rule rather than startsWith. Extend canonical matcher input with direct/official channel evidence and rank candidates by compatible owner, direct official canonical evidence, then deterministic completeness/tie-break data. Preserve buildModelIndex's maximum-score replacement when normalized variants converge.
acceptance: gpt-5 (high/medium/low/xhigh) variants converge and the maximum score wins
Base, Instruct, Chat, and Thinking architectures never collapse into each other
An organization hint can never fall back to an incompatible owner
Direct official canonical candidates win ambiguous compatible matches deterministically
HF derivative/repository matching remains owner-strict

findings.title: Aggregate canonical lifecycle with official-first and any-active semantics
evidence: lib/lifecycle.ts:18-34 correctly derives channel lifecycle
lib/lifecycle.ts:37-63 currently chooses the worst status across every channel
lib/catalog.ts:7-10 already has providerById and a snapshot-aligned date
lib/catalog.ts:23-70 invokes canonicalLifecycle during grouping and finalization
app/models/page.tsx:57-59 filters canonical lifecycle status

sealed-review:E5 found 65 mixed active/deprecated or sunset canonical IDs
findings.implementation: Pass provider metadata into canonicalLifecycle. If direct official channels exist, derive the canonical lifecycle only from those authoritative channels. Otherwise aggregate all channels by availability: any active channel makes the canonical model active; if none is active, a still-deprecated channel takes precedence over sunset, and only all-sunset channels yield sunset. Dates/source must come from the channels that determine the selected canonical status; channel-specific lifecycle remains available on each channel.
acceptance: An active official channel remains active despite a deprecated reseller
An official sunset overrides non-official reseller lifecycle evidence
Without official evidence, any active channel keeps the canonical model in onlyActive results
Without active channels, deprecated outranks sunset availability and all-sunset yields sunset

collision_boundaries: The worktree already contains user changes to next-env.d.ts and .workflow/state.json; implementation must not overwrite or normalize them.
The current run directory and sealed review directories are untracked Runtime/user artifacts; implementation may read but must not delete or rewrite them.
spec:project:ui-conventions-019 says checkbox, while the confirmed task changes presentation to one multi-select; retain every semantic clause and treat only the control shape as superseded.
Column reset and page reset are separate state domains: page reset may clear the page query, while reset-columns must preserve filters/sort and clear only one page-specific storage key.
Compare pagination must preserve spec:project:ui-conventions-020 explicit sort=none and default AAIndex-desc behavior.
Typed benchmark normalization must not leak into Hugging Face repository identity matching.
Lifecycle authority must use provider metadata already loaded by lib/catalog.ts; do not infer official status from display names alone.
Regenerating data/model-index.json is required implementation output, but data/models.json is the authoritative input and must not be regenerated or hand-edited for this fix.
